headline: AI Implementation and Customer Onboarding | Workflow and Decision-Logic Design | API Integrations | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: I spent four years at Greenway Health implementing software for close to 200 client practices: discovery, mapping how each team actually worked, configuring workflows and conditional logic, go-live and the troubleshooting after it. From August 2025 I was the clinical lead on an AI-first EHR, scoping which steps an AI agent could take over and where a person had to stay in the loop. I built Roovero and Pawlentine myself with Claude Code and Codex, including API and webhook integrations, and Roovero has paying pilot clients. I also grade ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude against rubrics I write.
greenway_bullets: Ran implementations for close to 200 client practices as their main contact, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, go-live and follow-up.

Designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets with conditional logic, for example a growth-chart widget that flags a BMI above a threshold and suggests the matching billing code for the provider to accept.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: mapped workflows, scoped where agentic automation could take routine work off staff, and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, and explained configuration choices in plain terms to non-technical teams.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests with product teams; many shipped to clients with positive feedback.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release on the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: discovery, workflow mapping, decision-tree and conditional-logic design, configuration, go-live, troubleshooting, training
LLM APIs, multi-model routing, prompt design, model evaluation rubrics, webhooks, Instagram Graph API, Razorpay billing, n8n
React, GitHub, Claude Code, Codex, Firebase, Next.js
thesis_html: An AI agent is only as good as the workflow it was set up for.
why_fit: Close to 200 client rollouts at Greenway, from kickoff to go-live.
I configured rule-driven workflows for clinics and wired APIs and webhooks into Roovero myself.
I scoped agent tasks for an AI-first EHR and shipped my own AI product to paying clients.
